name: Sachan Zaru Ganba
speaker: entity:sachan_zaru_ganba
lines: *The Sachan stands before a table covered in papers, deep in thought. He appears to snap out of it as you approach. You offer a respectful bow.* ...Ah. A comrade of the High Monk. You are welcome to the Sable Estate. Though, I pray you do not linger. Whatever business you have with me, conduct it now - I will not be staying around here for long.

*Zaru scoffs.* Soon, I will be departing the estate. There is nothing for us left here. [The Old Guard](faction:etrean_royalists) is no more. The civil war may as well be over in the East. Myself, my retainers, and most of my remaining force shall be headed West. To stop [the Lord Regent](entity:the_lord_regent), we must seek new allies elsewhere - without, a broad. There is little strength to be found within now, it seems.

*Zaru sighs.* Because the Old Guard is no more. The sachans have all gone their separate ways. During our discussion in the Golden Rat, tensions flared. We could not agree on a singular way forward, and the others - fools they are, - would not listen to me nor the High Monk. [Sachan Kobura](entity:sachan_shisui_kobura) insisted we join with the Authority, with her as our representative. Sachan Mofisu was adamant about recapturing the Monastery of Mur and his destroyed keep, and Sachan Anako sided with him.

My forces dwindle. I simply cannot afford to lose more warriors. That's all there is to it. Clan Ganba paid dearly in their defence of the Lord Guardian. *A bitter trembling rattles his voice.* My sons and daughters, my nephews and nieces, my grandchildren, my cousins... We lost many of our finest on the night of the Lord Regent's coup. The civil war has already cost us too many lives, and I simply cannot afford to keep sacrificing my kinsmen while the other clans refuse to cooperate.

*He clutches the scroll he is holding in his fist.* As I said - I shall head westward. I seek parley with foreign forces. Perhaps [the Hundred Legions](faction:the_hundred_legions) - although, I doubt they will respond to my offer. Or perhaps, I shall reach out to [the Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority). Sachan Kobura may have been right about them, in the end. Maybe the famed [Warden Jericho](entity:warden_jericho) will take pity on me, and aid my cause against our common enemy. Or perhaps he will simply throw me into the prisons of Cascabel to rot. What do you think... Ironsworn?

*Sachan Zaru smirks, sly as a fox.* You may drop your pretence. I know of your order. The Circle of Honour... I myself am not a member. But I know you are. I also know that the High Monk and Warden Jericho are also members of the organisation. Am I correct?

Tsch. You see, Clan Ganba were not only the Lord Guardian's royal guards. We were also frequently in the business of procuring intelligence. Espionage, if you will. I admit, I do not know much about your organisation. But I know that you seek to defeat the Lord Regent - and all that is all I wish as well. Hence... Perhaps I will make an offer to Warden Jericho. My cooperation for his assistance. Or perhaps, I will seek to join your order myself. I am yet to decide, if I am honest.
